review_candidates.title: Security Engineer (EU Remote)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Endpoint Security Management Maintain standards for Mac and Windows laptops used globally. What experience and qualifications should you have? Five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, security administration, infrastructure security, or a closely related role. What other requirements should you have? Integrity: Promise to uphold honesty as your compass and conduct all business practices with an ethical mindset and fiscal responsibility.
eligibility_evidence: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What experience and qualifications should you have? Five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, security administration, infrastructure security, or a closely related role. Thorough understanding and expertise in computer systems, networks, cloud technologies, applications, and security systems. Proficiency in working collaboratively across different functions and teams. What other requirements should you have? Proficiency in cloud infrastructure, Linux, virtualization technologies, and infrastructure automation.
